Ali Haider is a PR and communications professional with a career shaped by an instinct for narrative and an obsession with detail. In 2018, he founded Connect PR to bring a more considered, relationship-first approach to an industry often driven by noise.

Since then, he has worked across media relations, brand communications, and strategic counsel — building a practice defined by discretion, precision, and an editorial eye for what makes a story worth telling.
